results.name: Broadcom Inc.
results.description: Broadcom Inc. (formerly known as Broadcom Ltd.) designs, develops, and supplies semiconductor devices with a focus on analog III-V based products. The company was founded in August 2005. On February 1, 2016, Broadcom Corp. and Avago Technologies Ltd. merged to form Broadcom Ltd. (now Broadcom Inc.) The company redomiciled from Singapore to U.S. on April 4, 2018.

results.name: Avgol America Inc.
results.description: Avgol America, Inc. manufactures and supplies non-woven fabrics. The company is headquartered in Mocksville, NC. Manufactures and supplies non-woven fabrics.

results.name: Avgol Distribution Co. Inc.
results.description: Avgol Distribution Co., Inc., a subsidiary of Indorama Ventures Public Co. Ltd., is a company headquartered in the United States that distributes nonwoven fabrics. Distributes nonwoven fabrics.

results.name: Avgol India Pvt Ltd.
results.description: Avgol India Pvt Ltd., a subsidiary of Indorama Ventures Public Co. Ltd., is a company headquartered in Bhopal, India. The firm manufactures textile products. It was founded in 2011. Manufactures textile products.
